create_matcher_with_thresholds: create a Matcher instance with IOU thresholds [0.3, 0.5] and labels [0, -1, 1] for object detection
call_matcher_on_quality_matrix: call the Matcher on an MxN match quality matrix to get ground-truth matches and labels
enable_low_quality_matches: create a Matcher with allow_low_quality_matches=True to produce additional matches for low-quality predictions
review_set_low_quality_matches: review the set_low_quality_matches_ method that assigns positive labels to best-matching predictions per ground-truth
summarize_matcher_class: summarize the Matcher class that assigns predicted elements to ground-truth elements using a match quality matrix
